title: Punjab: 6 years on, farmers a strong pressure group but deep divisions a worry

ai.summary: Farmers in Punjab remain a strong pressure group despite internal divisions within their unions, with protests continuing ahead of 2027 assembly elections.

facts.claim: farmers remain a strong pressure group in Punjab
facts.quote: Having demonstrated their ability to mobilise mass protests and force the Centre to roll back its decisions, farmers remain a formidable pressure group in Punjab, especially ahead of the 2027 assembly elections

facts.claim: unions have fractured over demands and loyalties
facts.quote: Exactly six years ago, on November 26, 2020, farm unions gave the “Dilli Chalo” call, launching a historic protest that forced the Centre to repeal three farm laws. Today, that united front under the Samyukta Kisan Morcha (SKM) has fractured, with unions divided over their demands, loyalties and strategy.

The divisions within the movement have become more evident in the agitations that followed the 2020-21 stir. Since the AAP government took over in Punjab, two farm protests were withdrawn and demands remained unmet

ai.background_note: Farmers in Punjab have been a strong pressure group for six years, with protests continuing despite internal divisions within their unions ahead of 2027 assembly elections.
